sections.title: Who we are
sections.body: Voisino is operated by [publisher name, legal form, address, contact email]. The publisher is the data controller.

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.body: Account: email address, password managed by the authentication service, username, optional bio, and preferences. Posts: video recorded in the app, category, caption, location at the time of posting, and its accuracy. Interactions: Useful reactions, comments, reports, and appeals. Notifications: browser subscription details and selected area (a neighborhood of about 1 km², never your exact location). Security: salted, non-reversible hashes of IP addresses and email addresses to limit abuse.

sections.title: What we do not collect
sections.body: We do not keep a history of your locations: the location used to display the feed is not saved or logged. We do not collect profile photos or phone numbers, and we do not use advertising trackers.

sections.title: Video locations
sections.body: A video's exact location is retained to check its consistency and associate it with a neighborhood. It is never shown: everyone sees a location rounded to about 50 m and distances rounded to 100 m.

sections.title: Blurring
sections.body: Faces are automatically blurred before publication, and the unblurred original video is deleted once the processed version is online. Automatic blurring may miss very small or side-profile faces; report anyone who remains identifiable. Automatic license plate blurring is not currently active.

sections.title: Retention periods
sections.body: Videos: kept until they expire (6 hours to 7 days, depending on category), then the files are deleted. The post record (without the file) is kept for reputation history until the account is deleted. Videos removed by moderation: files are kept for 7 days (the appeal period), then deleted. Moderation log: kept to provide a record of decisions, using pseudonymous identifiers. Anti-abuse counters: 24 hours.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can export your data (Settings → My data), remove a video immediately, edit your information, and delete your account at any time. Account deletion removes your profile, videos and their files, comments, reactions, reports, and subscriptions. You can also contact us and lodge a complaint with the CNIL.

sections.title: Processors and service providers
sections.body: Database and file hosting: Supabase. Application hosting: Vercel. Video processing: [worker host]. Map tiles: OpenFreeMap / OpenStreetMap. Notifications: browser push services (Google, Apple, Mozilla). [Specify locations and transfer safeguards.]

sections.title: Purpose
sections.body: Voisino lets people share short videos that are useful to their neighborhood. The service is free of charge.

sections.title: Account
sections.body: Accounts are personal. You are responsible for what you post. We may suspend an account that violates the community rules.

sections.title: Content
sections.body: You retain your rights to your videos and grant us a non-exclusive, royalty-free license, limited to the period the video is visible, to show them to nearby users. You confirm that you have the right to record what you post and that you respect the rights of people shown.

sections.title: Moderation
sections.body: Users can report content to neighborhood moderators. After reports from three different people, a video is hidden pending review. Moderation decisions are logged and can be appealed; another person reviews the appeal. Content is not checked in advance.

sections.title: Not an emergency service
sections.body: Voisino does not replace emergency services. Call 112 if you are in danger.

sections.title: Liability
sections.body: Information posted by users is not checked in advance. [Liability clauses to be completed by a lawyer, including in light of hosting-provider status and the Digital Services Act.]

sections.title: Useful first
sections.body: Post what helps the neighborhood: an alert, practical information, an event, a helping hand, a found item, or an offer from a local business.

sections.title: Respect people
sections.body: Do not film people to feature them. Avoid faces, children, license plates, and precise addresses. No public shaming, harassment, hateful speech, or discrimination.

sections.title: Be truthful
sections.body: Do not post false information or misuse a category (an alert must be a real alert).

sections.title: Businesses
sections.body: Business offers are for approved merchant accounts, must use the Business category, and are subject to the daily quota.

sections.title: Reports and sanctions
sections.body: After reports from 3 different accounts, a video is hidden pending a neighborhood moderator’s decision. Decisions affect reputation; serious or repeated violations can lead to suspension.

sections.title: Write to us
sections.body: For questions, requests about your personal data, or urgent reports of illegal content: [contact email address].

sections.title: Report content
sections.body: The quickest way is to use the Report button below the video. It sends the report directly to neighborhood moderators.

sections.title: Authorities
sections.body: Requests from public authorities should be sent to [dedicated address].
